report_name: 'thegentlemen' Ransomware Group Targets Philippine Savings Bank

threat_actors.name: thegentlemen
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that emerged in late 2024, known for targeting mid-sized companies, particularly in the financial services sector. The group practices double extortion by exfiltrating data before encryption and threatening to leak it on their data leak site.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through ransomware and data leakage threats.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: As part of their double extortion model, 'thegentlemen' group deploys ransomware to encrypt servers and workstations, disrupting victim operations.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The 'thegentlemen' group practices double extortion, which involves stealing and exfiltrating sensitive customer and financial data before deploying ransomware for encryption.

tools.name: adfind.exe
tools.description: A legitimate but frequently abused tool for Active Directory reconnaissance, suggested as a hunting hint for detecting precursor activity related to groups like 'thegentlemen'.

tools.name: Mimikatz
tools.description: A credential dumping tool mentioned as something to monitor for in the context of detecting attacks from groups like 'thegentlemen'.

identities.name: Philippine Savings Bank
identities.description: A major consumer bank in the Philippines claimed as a victim by the 'thegentlemen' ransomware group on their data leak site.

infrastructure.name: thegentlemen Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A data leak site operated by 'thegentlemen' ransomware group to publish data from victims who do not pay the ransom. Philippine Savings Bank was listed on this site.

indicators.name: Active Directory Reconnaissance with nltest
indicators.pattern:
title: Active Directory Domain Trust Discovery with nltest
id: 2a8b1c1d-e3f4-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 'nltest.exe' to discover domain trust relationships, a common reconnaissance technique.
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-thegentlemen-hits-philippine-savings-bank/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-02
tags:
  - attack.t1482
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\nltest.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '/domain_trusts'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of 'nltest /domain_trusts', a command used for Active Directory reconnaissance, as suggested in the article's hunting hints.

indicators.name: Credential Dumping with Mimikatz
indicators.pattern:
title: Credential Dumping with Mimikatz
id: 4c0d3e3f-a5b6-4c7d-ae8f-9a0b1c2d3e4f
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of Mimikatz, a common tool for credential dumping, often by monitoring for access to the LSASS process memory.
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-thegentlemen-hits-philippine-savings-bank/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-02
tags:
  - attack.t1003.001
level: critical
logsource:
  category: process_access
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetImage|endswith: '\lsass.exe'
    GrantedAccess: '0x1010' # PROCESS_VM_READ | PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION
  filter:
    SourceImage|endswith:
      - '\procexp.exe'
      - '\procexp64.exe'
      - '\vmmap.exe'
      - '\procdump.exe'
      - '\procdump64.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects credential dumping activity using tools like Mimikatz, as recommended for detection in the article.

indicators.name: Domain Admins Group Discovery
indicators.pattern:
title: Domain Admins Group Discovery with Net Command
id: 5d1e4f4a-b6c7-4d8e-bf9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of the 'net' command to enumerate members of the 'Domain Admins' group.
references:
  - https://www.hookphish.com/blog/ransomware-group-thegentlemen-hits-philippine-savings-bank/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-02
tags:
  - attack.t1087.002
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\net.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'group'
      - 'Domain Admins'
      - '/domain'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of 'net group "Domain Admins" /domain' for reconnaissance, a pattern provided as a cyber observable in the report.
